THE
HOLY GOSPEL OF JESUS CHRIST,
ACCORDING TO ST. JOHN.
__________
INTRODUCTION.
St. John, the evangelist, a native of Bethsaida, in Galilee, was the son of Zebedee and Salome. He was called to be an apostle with his brother James, while they were mending their nets. (Witham) --- The last of the four gospels was written about the year 98. (Calmet)
